title: Value Object Configuration
description: Schema for foreline/crud value-object configuration files (config/crud/vo/**/*.json and vendor-shipped vo configs)

class.description: Fully-qualified class name of the value object (e.g. "Domain\\ValueObject\\Money\\Money"). Optional when the file path encodes the FQCN.

type.description: HTML input type override (e.g. "text", "number", "tel"). Ignored for parts rendered as <select>.

cssClasses.description: CSS classes appended to the inner <input> / <select> element

containerCssClasses.description: CSS classes appended to the inner field's wrapper <div>

attributes.description: HTML attributes emitted verbatim on the inner element. Names and values are HTML-escaped.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the inner input

required.description: Whether the inner field is required (defaults to true for int/float branches)

additionalProperties.description: UI configuration for a single inner field of the value object

parts.description: Inner-field configuration map, keyed by the value object's inner property name (e.g. "amount", "currency", "address")

ui.description: User-interface configuration for the value object

valueObject.description: Configuration for a single value object, identified by its fully-qualified class name
